description: Queue a draft to post at a later time, to every account in it. Call it only after the user said yes to this post and this time. Answers one delivery per account in state queued; a warning on a delivery means that account’s connection will lapse before then and the user should reconnect it. Refused when the time is further ahead than the plan schedules (usage_get says how far).

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

idempotencyKey.description: A key you make up for this one request, 8 to 200 characters (a UUID works). Repeating the request with the same key answers the same deliveries and never posts twice, so reuse it after a timeout. A key already used for another draft, version or time is refused.

scheduledAt.description: When to post, in UTC and ending in Z, for example 2026-11-06T14:00:00Z. Work it out from the user’s local time (usage_get names the workspace time zone). It must be in the future.

version.description: The draft’s version as you last read it. A different number is refused, so nothing goes out with content the user did not see.

name: schedule
title: Schedule a post
